guard_interpretation: Initial fresh import stopped at the 2 GiB additional disk budget, then continued from its own cache within a 512 MiB allowance.
First graphical NUnit run stopped below 3 GiB host free RAM; no XML was produced, so no test verdict was assigned.
CPU lifecycle tests subsequently used -nographics and --burst-disable-compilation; rendered six-scene UI ran with graphics and Burst compilation disabled.
Host disk deltas include concurrent OS activity; observed pagefile allocation does not explain or attribute the entire earlier growth.
Package caches were not shared or junctioned: byte audit found a generated ARCore test asset difference.
All figures are five-second samples, not continuous hardware peaks.
not_accepted: Fresh combined Main/Pose/Repair app-specific packages; all-scenes validation APK alone rebuilt

failure_history: Preflight initially rejected NUnit temporary scene; an erroneously started build was stopped and the owned temporary scene moved out of Assets.
Three runs stopped below the unchanged 3 GiB host RAM floor; jobs=1 and unused asset release alone did not resolve overlapping Editor/IL2CPP memory.

Offline full Player target was manually stopped because its graph requires Editor RPC. The audited codegen-only target completed conversion and returned 4 (DAG refresh required), not full-build success.

A later RSS stop was false: PID-only ancestry included older unrelated apps after PID reuse. Its owned-RSS numbers are invalid. Timestamp-edge regression tests and live ownership checks passed after the fix.
Native build then completed, but the 4 GiB additional disk guard stopped the Gradle phase. Cache size evidence was retained; pagefile allocation remained 2944 MiB.
A newly added disk parameter collided with an old statistic variable. The owned Editor and project-confirmed Gradle daemon were stopped; variable names and exception cleanup were fixed.
Windows job cleanup was added and tested with an orphan child and an unrelated sentinel.

First completed APK packaging was rejected because cached BuildReport had zero packed groups/entries. Only the approximately 60 MiB serialized PlayerDataCache was moved aside; native cache was retained. Fresh content serialization restored all 40 source bindings.
not_accepted: Scene recognition accuracy or full 13-class training acceptance
Fresh combined Main/Pose/Repair app-specific APKs; those existing binaries remain from the main workspace
